notesStmt.note: The manuscript is written on the reverse of an envelope that is postmarked Feb 22, 1890. The manuscript was therefore composed some time after that date but before the publication of Good-Bye My Fancy in May 1891.
A manuscript containing a draft title and subtitles for the volume ultimately published as Good-Bye My Fancy (1891).
